newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on technical correction.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on technical correction.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Wednesday on technical correction, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index closed 14.62 points, or 1.09 percent, up at 1,354.55 amid 121 losers and 81 gainers.
Dealer Khurram Hanif of Baring Securities attributed the rise to technical correction and covering of positions in the oversold market and said the rise was not sustainable.
PTCL rose 0.40 to 25.50 rupees, HUBCO 0.55 to 31.85, ICI 0.50 to 17.50, Dewan Salman 1.80 to 32.80, Sui Northern Gas 1.50 to 32 and Sui Southern Gas 1.00 to 25. Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
